findings.claim: The revised SPEC-CORE-099 I13 (invariants.md:7) promises that on any non-listing shelf page below 640px the sort menu stays on the header's last row at its right end, but no test checks that clause any more. The only phone-width I13 test (app-header.spec.ts:195-209) was rewritten to assert the listing-mode 'at its start' placement.
findings.impact: A later change could move the sort on a non-listing See all page at phone width (a provider entry page has no sort; a watch shelf without a profile, a Reading page with an unreadable key, or a page still looking up its Target do) to the left or onto another row. No test would fail, so the right-end promise the r1 revision kept would silently break.
findings.evidence: invariants.md:7 has a separate clause for 'any other shelf page below 640px … at its right end'. app-header.measure.ts:22 sets SHELF_PAGES = ['video-shelf','reading-shelf'], and the fixture opens those in listing mode. app-header.spec.ts:206 now asserts `Math.abs(sort.left - m.contentLeft) <= 1`. A grep for `contentRight` in e2e-components finds no remaining sort assertion against the right edge. The non-listing branch is VideoShelfPage.tsx:329-335 and ReadingShelfPage's equivalent `: (<ReadingSortMenu …/>)` branch.
findings.repro: Mutation: in VideoShelfPage.tsx:329-335, wrap the non-listing SortChoiceMenu in the same `flex-col items-start w-full` div that the listing branch uses. The sort on a watchBlocked page at 375px then moves to the left, and no unit or e2e test fails, because every I13 phone test opens a listing-mode page.

bucket_proposal.reason: This is a test coverage gap for a clause of the revised SPEC-CORE-099 I13. The code still keeps the non-listing branch unchanged, so no invariant is broken today.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a 375px app-header e2e case that opens a non-listing shelf page (for example video-shelf with by=watch and no profile) and asserts that the sort's last svg right edge equals contentRight.

specification_compliance: r1 F1 (bucket C) is addressed on paper: invariants.md:7 now carries a revision of SPEC-CORE-099 I13 that splits listing-mode shelf pages (field full-width, then the sort at its start on the line below) from other shelf pages (sort at the right end) below 640px. It also keeps 'sort left of the Target, after the name field' at 640px and wider. The code matches: VideoShelfPage.tsx:314-336 and ReadingShelfPage use a flex-col items-start wrapper only when `listing` is true.

The desktop clause (sort on the title row left of the Target) is still checked by app-header-desktop.spec.ts:61-83 at 640 and 1280px. The 'after the name field' order is checked by name-filter-desktop.spec.ts and seeAllNameFilter.test.tsx ('the field comes before the sort').

r1 F2-F5 (touch-point omissions: ClipShelfBlock.tsx, ime-enter-guard.test.ts, appTargetParam.test.tsx, the e2e registries and clipsAppHarness) were not reflected in the spec's touch-point list; a grep of docs/specs finds none of those names in app-library-name-filter.md. They were bucket B prose items, so the code is unaffected.
docs/specs/addon-app-header.md still states the original I13 (right end). The revision lives only in invariants.md, which this review process treats as the text in force.

No product code changed in commit 5c0a18297. The product files were re-read against the declared invariants. Spot checks: NameFilter scopeKey drop restores previousValueRef (NameFilter.tsx:106-113). Clips effectiveParams strips q on a Target switch (clips.tsx:173). The q normalisation replace is gated on libraryView (clips.tsx:193-205). See all filtersDropped clears requestedName (VideoShelfPage.tsx:136).
potential_unspecified_behavior: While the Target of a Video or Reading See all page is still being looked up, `params` is null, so `listing` is false (VideoShelfPage.tsx:137). The header first draws the bare sort at the right end, then switches to the field-plus-sort column once the Target resolves, so the layout jumps on phone. The revised I13 classifies this state as 'any other shelf page', so it is consistent, but it is a visible relayout.
regression_risks: The non-listing branch of the phone I13 placement has no e2e guard (F1).

The I13 text in addon-app-header.md and the revision in invariants.md now differ. A reader who edits addon-app-header.md without seeing invariants.md may 'restore' the right-end rule for every shelf page.
test_coverage: Listing-mode shelf page at 375px: covered by app-header.spec.ts:195-209 (sort at the start, below the header rows) and by name-filter.spec.ts's See all case (field full-width, sort below it at the field's x).
Non-listing shelf page at <640px: no test (F1).

At 640px and wider: app-header-desktop.spec.ts:61-83 checks that the sort is on the title row, left of the Target. name-filter-desktop.spec.ts checks that the field is before the sort on one row at 1024, 1280 and 1440px.
NameFilter's scopeKey restore of the applied name is covered by NameFilter.test.tsx ('a scopeKey change that drops a pending apply shows the name in force').

trajectory: Round r1 → fix commit 5c0a18297 changes documents only: it adds a revision of SPEC-CORE-099 I13 to invariants.md and records the r1 decision. The revision adds a branch to the invariant (listing-mode vs other shelf pages below 640px) that mirrors the `listing ? … : …` branch already in VideoShelfPage and ReadingShelfPage. No code branch, state or prediction was added or removed in this round. Only one fix round exists, so there is no repeating pattern of the design being patched. The new invariant branch has no test on its non-listing side (F1).
